requests.prompt: Create one original adult anime character portrait. Clean tapering black ink outlines, flat cel colours, hard angular two-tone shadows. A confident adult navigator with short black bob hair, warm brown eyes, a vermilion jacket and a cream high collar. Head and upper shoulders, front-facing, generous space around the hair, square composition, plain light neutral background. No lettering, watermark, logos or extra people.

Keep the same adult character identity and black bob hairstyle from the reference image. Change the jacket to deep indigo with a cream high collar and add small silver earrings. Give the character a subtle warm smile. Warm editorial illustration with restrained colours and soft painterly shadows. Front-facing head and shoulders, full hair visible, generous clearance and plain light background. No text or logos.
